candidate.answerReason: The angle bisectors and parallel line give BM = MO and CN = NO. These equalities make the perimeter of AMN equal to AB + AC = 30.

methods.label: Find two isosceles triangles
methods.explanation:
The useful observation is that the parallel line turns each angle-bisector condition into a pair of equal angles. This lets us replace the two parts of \(MN\) with lengths along the sides of the large triangle.

Because \(M\) lies on \(AB\), the bisector at \(B\) gives \(\angle MBO=\angle OBC\). Also, \(MN\parallel BC\) gives \(\angle BOM=\angle OBC\). Thus \(\angle MBO=\angle BOM\), so triangle \(BMO\) is isosceles and \(BM=MO\).

Similarly, the bisector at \(C\) and the parallel lines give
\[
\angle NCO=\angle OCB=\angle CON.
\]
Therefore triangle \(CNO\) is isosceles and \(CN=NO\).

As shown in the figure, \(O\) lies between \(M\) and \(N\). Consequently,
\[
MN=MO+ON=BM+CN.
\]
The perimeter is therefore
\[
\begin{aligned}
AM+MN+AN
&=(AB-BM)+(BM+CN)+(AC-CN)\\
&=AB+AC\\
&=12+18=30.
\end{aligned}
\]
The answer is \(\boxed{30}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{A}}\).
